title: Lost Shacks
dek: A named site on Prima’s northwestern coastal land.
body:
Lost Shacks is marked on the northwestern coastal land of Prima, north of the Thundering Coast.

The place on the map

The name and location are established by the island map. Its inhabitants, buildings, and history remain unconfirmed.
sources: Prima island map · Lost Shacks label, northwestern coast north of Thundering Coast · assets/archive/prima-map.jpg
